name: Guangzhou Restaurant Group Company Limited
summary: Guangzhou Restaurant Group Co.,Ltd. is a prominent hospitality company that manages and operates a network of dining establishments both within China and across international territories. Its diverse culinary offerings span a range of products, including traditional mooncakes, frozen items, cured meats (Lap Mei), biscuits, pastries, Western-style cakes, and convenient ready-to-eat meals. Furthermore, the group extends its services to include comprehensive catering. The company holds ownership of various restaurant brands, including prominent names like Guangzhou Restaurant, Tao Tao Ju, Likou Fu, Autumn Wind, and Liang Feng Yuan. In addition to these brands, it directly manages and operates 26 catering stores, which function under specific brand identities such as Guangzhou Restaurant, Tao Tao Ju, Tian Ji Pin, and Xingyue City. Established in 1935, the company's corporate headquarters are situated in Guangzhou, China.
